tt0106064.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
tt0106064.description: A team of teenagers with attitude are recruited to save Angel Grove from the evil witch, Rita Repulsa, and later, Lord Zedd, Emperor of all he sees, and their hordes of different monsters whom they use to try to conquer the earth.

tt0115319.name: Power Rangers Zeo
tt0115319.description: Tommy, Billy, Adam, Rocky, Kat and Tanya are turned back to their teenage forms thanks to the Zeo Crystal. The Command Center is gone but the crystal leads them to the new Power Chamber and all but Billy take on new Zeo powers.

tt0118436.name: Power Rangers Turbo
tt0118436.description: Divatox has begun her invasion on Earth and the Power Rangers trade in their Zeo crystal powers for Turbo technology powers to combat this new threat.

tt0120575.name: Power Rangers in Space
tt0120575.description: The most evil forces in the universe, Rita and Zedd, Machine Empire and Divatox, have formed an alliance with the monarch of all evil, Dark Spectre.

tt0175059.name: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy
tt0175059.description: In a strange galaxy far, far away, the evil Scorpius attacks an innocent planet. Five brave teenagers rush to defend it and discover that they have been chosen to be protectors of the universe.

tt0212686.name: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue
tt0212686.description: Five young adults are recruited by the Lightspeed Rescue organization to protect the city of Marnier Bay from the forces of evil.

tt0256278.name: Power Rangers Time Force
tt0256278.description: The Time Force Power Rangers travel to the past to stop Ransik and his band of criminal mutants.

tt0287871.name: Power Rangers Wild Force
tt0287871.description: Five teenagers are chosen by five Power Animals to become the Wild Force Rangers, to fight the evil Jinderax and Toxica and their evil Orgs.

tt0312189.name: Power Rangers Ninja Storm
tt0312189.description: A trio of ninja trainees become Power Rangers to defend their school after it is attacked by aliens.

tt0373587.name: Power Rangers DinoThunder
tt0373587.description: A team of unlikely personalities join forces to help save the Earth from the scheming Mesogog, a dinosaur-like villain who wishes to destroy humankind.

tt0414762.name: Power Rangers S.P.D.
tt0414762.description: When the Earth is threatened by the evil Troobian empire, the SPD (Space Patrol Delta) police force recruits a team of Power Rangers to help defend the planet.

tt0451469.name: Power Rangers Mystic Force
tt0451469.description: Five teen sorcerers are called to save the planet from darkness, guided by their mentor and an ancient book. They embark on magical adventures, befriend dragons, battle beasts, face evil, and transform into the Power Rangers Mysti...

tt0784920.name: Power Rangers Operation Overdrive
tt0784920.description: Five teenagers must locate and secure ancient relics with unbelievable power, while at the same time stop a demonic corporation who want the relics for their power.

tt1121628.name: Power Rangers Jungle Fury
tt1121628.description: Three teenagers from the Pai Zhug Kung Fu Academy are chosen to fight the forces of an opposing academy and all other forces of evil.

tt1304612.name: Power Rangers R.P.M.
tt1304612.description: The computer virus Venjix wants to attack and destroy Corinth, the only city on Earth to survive its massacre. With the help of advanced biotechnology, RPM Power Rangers must save humanity and defeat Venjix.

tt1704503.name: Power Rangers Samurai
tt1704503.description: Five teenagers inherit samurai powers from ancient Japan to protect the world from an army of monsters.

tt2236126.name: Power Rangers Megaforce
tt2236126.description: An evil galactic armada has come to destroy the planet Earth and the newest team of Power Rangers must harness powers from Rangers of the past to stop them as the Power Rangers Megaforce.

tt3521854.name: Power Rangers Dino Charge
tt3521854.description: In prehistoric times, an alien entrusted 10 powerful Energemas to 10 dinosaurs, and these were lost with their extinction. Now an intergalactic bounty hunter seeks to reclaim the Energemas and destroy the Earth.

tt5335606.name: Power Rangers Ninja Steel
tt5335606.description: A new team of superhuman power rangers must work together and use their new ninja powers to prevent evil from dominating the human race and from destroying the planet earth and the universe

tt8022978.name: Power Rangers Beast Morphers
tt8022978.description: Set in the future, a secret agency combines a newly discovered substance called "Morph-X" with animal DNA to create the Power Rangers Beast Morphers team.

tt12360292.name: Power Rangers Dino Fury
tt12360292.description: When an army of powerful alien beings is unleashed on Earth threatening life as we know it, a brand-new team of Power Rangers, fueled by the prehistoric power of the dinosaurs, are recruited to deal with the threat.

tt29474102.name: Power Rangers Cosmic Fury
tt29474102.description: When Lord Zedd returns more powerful than ever, Team Cosmic Fury takes to the cosmos to battle the emperor of evil, and save the universe as we know it.

tt0113820.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: The Movie
tt0113820.description: A giant egg is unearthed at a construction site and soon opened, releasing the terrible Ivan Ooze, who wreaks vengeance on Zordon for imprisoning him millennia ago. With Zordon dying and their powers lost, the Rangers head to a di...

tt0120389.name: Turbo: A Power Rangers Movie
tt0120389.description: A space alien is threatening to bring destruction on Earth, and the Power Rangers are enhanced with turbo powers in order to prevent her plan.

tt6099542.name: Power Rangers Samurai: Clash of the Red Rangers - The Movie
tt6099542.description: The Samurai Rangers team up with the mysterious RPM Ranger Red to fight off Master Xandred's Mooger army and a robotic supervillain from the RPM Ranger's dimension. But when both Red Rangers get struck with hypnobolts, they turn against one another.

tt2367036.name: Power Rangers Monster Bash Halloween Special
tt2367036.description: Halloween is every Nighlok's favorite day, so the creepiest creatures are dying to get into the scariest party ever and trade stories about their battles with the Samurai Power Rangers.

tt4962796.name: Power Rangers Super Megaforce: The Legendary Battle
tt4962796.description: As Orion leaves to go back to his home planet, Tensou discovers a radio frequency from Emperor Mavro stating he will use his entire Armada to invade Earth! The Rangers fight back and they ...

tt3717490.name: Power Rangers
tt3717490.description: When Earth is on the verge of an alien invasion, five teenagers, who are infused with superhuman abilities, must harness their newfound powers to battle this threat - as the Power Rangers.

tt23219684.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Once & Always
tt23219684.description: After killing Trini, Rita, kidnaps rangers to use for her time machine in order to stop the past and reign over all evil. Billy, Zach, Rocky and Kat reunite to face Rita and her allies. But Min, Trini's daughter is determined for ...
